findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "save_my_agent_draft" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Use this only when the signed-in owner explicitly asks to create or edit their MyLegend agent. Save only the fields they choose to share from this conversation,…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile, get_my_agent_draft, save_my_agent_draft · Private data: get_profile, get_my_agent_draft, save_my_agent_draft · Public sink: save_my_agent_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile, get_my_agent_draft, save_my_agent_draft · Private data: get_profile, get_my_agent_draft, save_my_agent_draft · Public sink: save_my_agent_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
